name: Field Mechanic (Item Creation)
body:
Prerequisites(s): Knowledge (engineering) 5 ranks, Craft (mechanical) 5 ranks, Technologist.

Benefit(s): When creating technological items, you no longer require a lab. However, if you craft a technological item without the use of the appropriate lab, the Craft DC increases by 10.

Special: This feat may be restricted at GM discretion, as not all GMs may wish for free crafting of technological items.
